reviews.text: Everyone working here is very nice and competent. I highly recommend them.
Thank you for the 5-star rating! We're glad to know you had a positive experience with us. We look forward to seeing you and your pet again soon!

What a wonderful Vet Clinic, our little fur baby does not like going to these but this place was just so nice.  The staff is really nice and concerned about your pet, the location is clean and the doctors are really nice. They truly care and it is nothing like other vet clinics we use to go to. Very happy we found this place and will be going back for more checkups.
Love this team. Always feel like our girl is so well taken care of. Many thanks!

Service is always prompt, detailed and friendly. The staff take care to listen and understand your reason for the visit. They are great with my dogs and always work to make them feel comfortable. Pricing is transparent with options given. Overall, I highly recommend them.

The staff is very friendly, organized and clean. For the most part they have always made an effort to get my pet in quickly. Staff is knowledgeable and professional. Dr Oyan is a great doctor and genuinely loves animals. She explains everything thoroughly and listens to my concerns without rushing.
Great folks here at Phx Dog Cat Bird Hospital, they have taken great care of us and our Pups
Dr. Heather Oyan was great with my cat, Baxter.  She was unhurried,  kind, and seemed to actually enjoy spending time with him.  I highly recommend her and Phoenix Dog Cat Bird Hospital.
Great vets and techs here. They listen to my concerns and answer any questions I have.
Staff was great I was in and out in no time highly recommend it was a bit far to drive but for the service I would go again
Expedient, caring, knowledgeable and kind!

This was the best vet experience we’ve ever had. The technician and veterinarian were both very helpful, thorough and made our pups as comfortable as possible. They explained the medication and different options available and there was no high pressure sales to do unnecessary work.
Libby, your 5-star rating means a lot to us! We're delighted you had a great visit. Looking forward to your next visit with your pet.

Staff are warm, thoughtful, and competent. They thoroughly listened to my concerns and provided top notch care to my animals.  Costs were very reasonable and communicated to me clearly early in the process. The facilities are modern, clean, well-maintained, and comfortable. I would highly recommend this vet to any in the Phoenix area.
The whole staff is terrific and supportive. The best vet Sonny the cat has had in his very long life! (They're helping to make it longer.)

Dr. "O" and the vet techs as well as the front desk have helped our family with our fur babies medical care and treatment. We feel like family when asking for their medical care. So compassionate as well.

I'm very pleased with my experience at PDCBH, I was greeted warmly by the front desk staff, the vet tech was very friendly and knowledgeable and very patient with my shy puppies. Dr Oyan was very through and gentle during the examination and answered my litany of questions with a smile. Highly recommend this practice.
They took great care of my dog and listened to our concerns. I highly recommend!

Everyone here cares. They take extraordinary care of the animals, and honestly, the humans, too. Super understanding and just genuine people. One time, I couldn’t get the cats into their bags and called the front desk stressed out. They were more than understanding, totally non-judgmental, calming, and reassuring. Another time I asked for a 90-day supply of high blood pressure medicine and they accommodated. While their humanity sets them apart (far apart), prices are fair, appointments go smoothly and run on time, and facilities are clean and well maintained. Impressive.
It's the best veterinary hospital in town. All of the staff and doctors are amazing. The only place and people I trust to care for my little fur baby Gizmo.
JulieAnn, thank you so much for taking the time to leave us this amazing review!
Jacqueline, thank you so much for taking the time to leave this awesome review.
They treated me and Diamond with compassion and kindness. Thank you for your patience with my questions and concerns. Very helpful explaining everything to me.
Thank you so much for taking the time to leave us this amazing review!

Dr. Grossman and Alison were incredible with Meena. As a first time cat owner, I think I was more anxious than Meena was and they were patient and thorough with Meena and I. Definitely put me at ease and I feel comfort in knowing I found our vet group!
Sick cat.  Bery empathetic; efficient service/care.
Thank you for the paw-some rating, Paul!

The best vets my dog, Fred, has ever had. The doctors and staff go above and beyond to make Fred feel like part of their family. Anyone who loves their pet, should choose Phoenix Dog Cat Bird Hospital.
Everyone is pleasant and clearly loves working with their fur patients.   Very efficient-in and out quickly. Overall a positive experience.
great price, thorough exam for my dog, kind people who show their love for pets
took my dogs there and they was  great  and knew the problem they wasbhave at a reasonable  cost will go again
Jill, thank you so much for taking the time to leave us this amazing review!
We appreciate you taking the time to leave us a positive rating. Thank you for choosing us, Luz!

Great experience. Everyone was helpful, cordial, and friendly. The place was clean, well-organized, and had good parking.
Prices are clear and reasonable.
We're so happy you had a great experience. Thank you for sharing, Judith!
My daughter an i have been coming here for many years. Always a great experiance!
My dog was so much better after going in for infection symptoms
Thank you, Thomas, for your 5-star rating!  🐾 …
Best vet ever!
Now I Take my cat here and there very professional and quick... her nails clipped and shot's... within an hour

This is without a doubt the best veterinary practice I have ever experienced.  Every single person there is a sincere animal lover.  The doctors are highly trained with various subspecialties.  The vet techs and surgical assistants are also highly trained and caring with the animals. Even the office staff is committed to the highest quality and most loving pet care.  I cannot recommend them highly enough.  They are the best.
Dear Don, your 5-star rating means the world to us! We deeply appreciate your loyalty and are thrilled that you had such a positive experience with us.
Thank you so much, Alyssa, for your wonderful 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your support. 🐾 …
Thank you, Darian, for your generous 5-star rating! Your support means a lot to us!

I am so disappointed. In a moment of pain and distraction. No one had my back.  I have been a patron of Bird Cat and Dog for over ten years with several pets and I made the mistake they knew me.  Its my fault for not reviewing my bill and letting it be emailed but my beloved EB went general cremation and no one stopped to ask was that what I was wanting. I did not want his paw or picture frame I was clear but his ashes were not discussed. Even though  you are grieving be sure to review your bill (cost was never an issue for me) to be honest I had not looked at bill as it was painful. You need to verbal state you want the ashes if that is you wish. I thought they understood as I have always done and discussed he was going with the rest in my pet ash garden.  I have done many ALWAYS getting ashes back from them. Its my fault but when you are not thinking this can happen.

Outstanding care.  Amazing and caring staff.  Reasonable prices.  I’ve been to the vet many times but this last time my dog somehow got out of her collar as we were trying to get through the door.  I went running to try to catch her but she was half way down the street.  Before I knew it two staff came running with their leashes and they were able to get my dog to safety.  I was a mess by the time all this was over and we went in for our appt.  The staff were so kind offering me emotional support and water.  They helped save my dogs life and comforted me ~ I’m still so touched and thankful.
Thank you, Daryl, for your thoughtful 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your feedback and are grateful to hear that your experience with us was a positive one. 🐾 …
We have always been treated with respect and kindness at Phx Dog, Cat Bird. The team of veterinarians are all thoughtful and competent

The receptionist was so patient, kind, and friendly and extremely informative when I brought my pet budgie, Henry, in for the first time. Dr. Schneider was wonderful! I was pleasantly surprised how thorough they were with Henry’s annual exam which gave me peace as a first time bird owner. She was very informative and gave me multiple tips and answered all of my questions with diet information. I like how she involved me in her check up on Henry so that I can know what to look for. She is an expert with birds especially and was very personable! Highly recommend!
Took my cat Frida to get her first dental cleaning here. The staff were so friendly and helpful. They answered all of my questions and took great care of her!

Our dog is extremely anxious of the vet. He can be difficult but doesn’t bite. The vet and techs go slow and don’t force anything but still gets what needs to be done. I’m glad we found them when we first got our dog and will keep bringing him back.
Thank you so much for your 5-star rating! Your support means a lot to us. 🐾 …
They were super friendly and professional and treated my dog like family! I would recommend them over and over again! Very fair in prices and actual need for medication’s!
Phx dog staff is great! Wilbur has us all under his spell and gets great care! Thank you! 😁 …
The staff is friendly and helpful. Dr. Snyder is amazing! I couldn't ask for a better vet for my dog Lola. So grateful.

We live right down the street from this clinic so it was convenient to take our animals. Because of the convenience, we tolerated several things. Their prices are high, and they’re not very welcoming when you walk in. After feeling completely dismissed following several incidents, we decided to take our business elsewhere. At our last visit, after standing in the lobby for a good solid 15 minutes while the lady was on the phone. Someone else came out and told us that they were very busy and we should take our pet elsewhere. 😳They suggested we go to Arkvets because it might be more affordable for us. That statement really felt like a jab. When we got outside, I asked my husband, do we look homeless?. No we do not look homeless, we look like worried, pet parents that just jumped up and threw clothes on. Well, we took their snarky advice, and we could not be more pleased. We are treated with kindness. We are welcomed in the facility and they’re very upfront with their pricing. Turns out it is MUCH  less expensive than this place. So thank you SNARKY former vet tech. We couldn’t be happier.
Thank you, Jaime, for your wonderful 5-star rating!
Fabulous caring service, responsive staff when i call, friendly and comforting to my pet
Extremely kind and gentle vet and vet tech. My new rescue was at ease there which just says a lot.

Outstanding staff. I've been to a couple other larger-chain vet clinics and never felt comfortable with staff that were always trying to tack on additional and unnecessary charges. My cat still hates going to the vet, but at least his humans are much more comfortable.
Thank you, Mary, for your wonderful 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your support!

It can be really hard finding a vet office that is kind, helpful, and accommodating, but this place is all of those things and more! Everyone is so kind, they are helpful and caring, and it always feels clean and calm in there. I would definitely recommend!

I have been a client of Phoenix Dog Cat Bird Hospital since moving to Phoenix in early 2000's, and Their vets are knowledgeable, caring, and treat each pet as if it were their own. Everyone in the office - from the doctors to the administrators to the techs and reception staff are Fantastic. You are always greeted warmly, and my Dogs, are treated like the family that they are.

I cannot say enough about PDCBH. They are absolutely fantastic. They are always so great with my extremely anxious pup and always so helpful. Great prices, very friendly and honest and they take the time to get your animal as comfortable as possible. My poor guy was bit last night at doggy daycare and they got him right in the next day and he’s doing great. Even after moving to the East Valley I still drive out because they are the absolute best vet I’ve been to.
Thank you, Debra, for your generous 5-star rating! We're delighted to hear that you had a positive experience with us, and we truly appreciate your support.
Great vet. All staff are friendly. Wait time is short. Prices are reasonable.
Thank you, Candice, for your kind 5-star rating! We're grateful for your support and truly appreciate your feedback. It’s heartening to hear that you had a positive experience with us.
Absolutely awesome people and service here!
Great with my cats.

I find the staff to be a very caring team.
We always are treated with patience, no matter what! My questions are answered, and if not, I am gotten back to very quickly, appointments are made timely and I feel a genuine sense of concern when trying to help my pet and I get through a rough spot 🙏🏽❤️ Love Phoenix Dog, Cat, Bird Hospital ❤️🙏🏽
Thorough exam, fair pricing and super friendly staff and veterinarians!
Thank you, Gustavo, for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to hear that you had a positive experience with us, and we truly appreciate your feedback.
Been coming here a long time, and theyre always wonderful and caring. My boys Trunks and Vegeta are always well taken care of, and the vets and staff are amazing

Thank you so much, Renee, for your wonderful 5-star rating! We genuinely appreciate your feedback and are so glad to hear that you had a positive experience with us. Your satisfaction means a lot to us!
I’ve been bringing my cats here for over 20 years. Everyone is consistently absolutely fabulous. I wouldn’t go anywhere else with my pets. Thank you! 😻 …

Very compassionate, competent staff, techs and vets.  Able to manage and connect with each animal's behavior, needs.  Able to schedule appointments easily.  We have been with Dr. Sosnow and crew for years with all our animals.

The staff was very friendly. The waiting room was not over crowed, like a lot of Vets, and when a dog came in or left that was not very social, they put that dog in a room and also let them leave by another exit. The Vet was great and very knowledgeable.

This is the only veterinarian that my Peppe' likes to go to. Every time we leave from this veterinarian hospital, he is very happy which makes me happy. He trusts the veterinarians here and this is the only place that he will accept treats from them. Anywhere else he won't accept the treats from their hand or from their place. If that tells you anything.
The employees here have always been very very helpful, very very friendly and very understanding. I always have a wonderful experience whether it's on the phone or in person. I feel very comfortable using this veterinarian and I would refer this veterinarian hospital to anybody looking for a veterinarian.

Thank you, Sydney, for your 5-star rating! We truly value your support and are delighted to hear about your positive experience. Your feedback inspires us to continue overcoming challenges and striving for excellence.

Everyone here takes excellent care of your pets! Dr. Sosnow is amazing, incredibly down to earth and straight to the point. Dr Gifford is also amazing.

Update: Have been going here for many years and still continues to be a great place for pet care. They have been managing my dogs Addison's and she is doing great.

I am a groomer and knicked a dogs tongue. Its been years so of course I was panicking and felt terrible but the staff there helped me get help for my client baby. She turned out totally okay but I am so grateful. Thank you for helping me out and taking care of her. It gives both me and my client peace of mind. Thank you again!
They were super down to earth and chill and it was not terrible expensive . I highly reccomend .

We took our dog to phoenix dog cat bird for the last 3 years, and we can’t say enough good things about the doctors and the facility. Our pup loved going to the vet, the nurses and doctors were always so loving and kind to him. We’re sad to be moving away, but wanted to share how amazing our experience always was. Be sure to take
all your furry friends to phoenix dog cat bird, you’ll be glad you did!

I have been going to Phoenix Dog Cat Bird Hospital for years with my cats. They have always been good to me and my cats. Recently I had a bad experience with UC not providing full discharge education for my cat’s new diagnosis. They also did not provide instruction for how to store medication and to shake it before hand. It was a mess and the lack of care, instructions, and proper education could have been dangerous for my cat and his recovery. I was able to call PDCBH and they were so helpful with giving me advice over the phone and getting my baby in to be seen quickly. They got the urine sample that the UC vet failed to do and even told me they gave him forehead kisses while doing so! I fully trust them with my kiddos and after such a bad experience with UC I am SO GLAD to have a team like this I can trust! THANK YOU!

Phoenix Dog Cat Bird Hospital is absolutely wonderful! Every member of the staff is incredibly caring, knowledgeable, and truly committed to the well-being of the animals they treat. They take the time to answer questions, explain options, and make sure pets and owners feel comfortable and supported. Their prices are very reasonable, and I really appreciate their convenient hours, which make scheduling so much easier. You can tell they genuinely love what they do, and it shows in the quality of care they provide. Highly recommend!

I have a reactive dog that can be very fearful of strangers. Today she was seen by Lara Sosnow and she was incredible! Very thorough exam, very communicative and it was obvious she is an animal lover. Everyone there went out of their way to make my dog feel safe and comfortable and I’m so grateful they took the extra time to take great care of my girl.
You won’t be disappointed with the staff that cares for your pet! From the receptionist, the Tech, to the Physician, they are all amazing!!!!
Picked up my friends cat after overnight stay for a biopsy.
Thank you, DaEe, for your wonderful 5-star rating! We're truly grateful to hear that you had a positive experience with us, and we appreciate the opportunity to serve you.
Another amazing experience! Our vet and staff are truly amazing. Hands down the best vet I have taken my dog to.
Thank you, Rafael, for your generous 5-star rating!

Phoenix dog, cat, bird has been our favorite vet for 8 years! I’ve brought all of my animals and quite a few rescue cats here to be seen over the years. The staff is knowledgeable and kind and have helped me through all stages of my kitties lives.
Very friendly staff and convenient, also the cost is very reasonable
Best vets I've ever had. Very caring people, all of them & open 7 days a week!
Appreciated the kindness and concern for my dog.
Thanks for such nice words, Cheri! We are so happy to get to have such awesome clients like you!

Our first puppy oak ! This place literally made it feel like home ! Easy process ! Puppy package ! Easy appointments! Very very very very x100 very friendly people working here. Different personalities of people working here and each person made our experience awesome ! I wish I could remember names. But everyone here deserves a pat in the back !
Hello Dora, your kind 5-star rating warms our hearts! We're so grateful to hear that you had a wonderful experience.
My first visit.  Staff are very friendly and doctors are very informative and friendly.  Very nice that the facility honored military discount for veterans.
Everyone at this clinic was incredibly kind. Highly recommend them for your furbabies' needs.
Great veterinary clinic. Excellent service and very caring staff. Absolutely fantastic with my cat.
We take all of our dogs here! We just love the staff and the high level of care our dogs receive.
Everyone here is so sweet and so caring! You can tell they really do care about you and the health of your animals. They are so understanding. I'm so grateful to have found them!!

I called in a panic to schedule care for my cat who suddenly got sick—and the girl on the phone, without hesitation, told me my dog was listed as deceased. As if I needed that reminder. As if I’ve somehow forgotten.
He was my best friend. Losing him shattered me. And to hear it brought up so casually—like reading off a grocery list—was gutting. What’s worse is all of my babies on file she listed have passed. You didn’t need to say it. You just added more pain to a day that was already unbearable.
I’m so tired of vet office front desks being cold, careless, and checked out. Laughing about weekend plans, gossiping, acting like the job is an inconvenience. You are the first and last impression. And some of us are walking in or calling during the worst moments of our lives.
Please remember that. You don't know what someone’s holding onto just to make that call.
Do better!

The veterinarian is awesome. They treat my tiny poodles like princesses. And when I needed to put my elderly dog over the rainbow bridge, they let me come in immediately. My usual vet was “too busy” and is now my ex-vet.
Shadow And Daisy..!!

Refreshingly good all around.  From the first contact while making his appointment. the visit and follow up.  I will tell everyone I know about your practice.  Plus the days of week open.  Thank you for all you do@

Going to the vet is sometimes scary for most pets but my dog Stormi is always comforted and cared for by all the friendly techs and also by the Vet when she has seen her. We are so thankful for the kind help in getting Stormi the care she needs whether it is a yearly checkup or her allergy treatment. Also how easy it is to schedule online for existing pet patients. Also to the friendly front desk staff. Thank you Phoenix Dog Cat Bird Hospital for all you do!
Hello Lisa, we appreciate your feedback and are pleased to hear that you had a positive experience!
Caring, friendly, quick, and easy

I walked in and immediately felt like I was in good hands. I was early for my appointment and they walked me straight back, which was wonderful because that meant I could get Snaps out of the carrier, which causes her a great deal of distress. Allison was amazing, you could see her love for animals and she made both me and my kitty feel so comfortable in what was a scary moment for us both. Dr. Schlisler was knowledgeable, professional, and compassionate. I will now only take my babies to Phoenix Dog Cat and Bird Hospital and have already recommended them to my friends with fur babies. I am incredibly grateful for the help and service I received.
Hi Lisa, your 5-star rating is greatly appreciated! Your support means a lot to us, thank you!

My sister and I took her cat Papas to Phoenix Dog Cat Bird Hospital to continue care with one of the most wonderful vets you will ever meet, Dr. M. Kirk. Dr. Kirk has taken care of Papas since he broke his paw several months previous. We were lucky to meet her at Banfield Hospital in Chandler and we followed her to Phoenix Dog Cat Bird Hospital in Phoenix. The staff are friendly, caring and compassionate.   We never had to wait long to get his paw rebandaged. Dr. Kirk is a great vet that cares not only for her patient but also the patient's family.  I highly recommend taking your pet to Dr. Kirk and Phoenix Dog Cat Bird Hospital if your pet requires veterinary care.

All the doctors and staff are amazing. They’re so polite and knowledgeable and really love the animals.Dr. Sosnow And Dr. Gifford’s won my heart from my very first visit when they got down on the floor with my animals to be closer to them and to make them feel more comfortable. I would give them more stars if there was more available.
Super friendly staff. Extremely helpful!
Phenix Dog Cat bird hospital really cares about your pet. We have been going there for years, we love our vet Dr. Sosnow, very compassionate and loves our dogs as much as we do.
Friendly caring  professional staff. I trust them.

The staff here are really nice. I used to take my cats to Dreamy Draw but they joined this location. Sadly I just paid $900 for a dental cleaning and extraction for my kitty and they somehow didn’t even notice that she had cancer in her mouth. She was having a hard time eating so I took her here with videos of the way she’s been struggling and they said her mouth and teeth looked normal but they wouldn’t be able to see until they took x-rays, so I scheduled a dental cleaning with the expectation of needing a tooth pulled once they got in there. I even paid extra for full chest x-rays because she’s getting older and I could tell something was going on with her. The vets were impressed with her health and told me she was in great shape so I thought the tooth extraction would provide the relief she’d been needing.
When she never returned to eating normally after her dental procedure I took her back and they recommended me to an oral specialist.   I then scheduled an appointment with the Arizona Veterinary Dental Specialists in Gilbert, where Dr. Balke, who was amazing, told me that she unfortunately had cancer. That her tongue was hard and adhering itself to the bottom of her mouth. I had to help her eat and clean herself. She was so hungry and thirsty. I had to put her down yesterday and I’m absolutely destroyed. The oral specialist said she didn’t have much time left and I had to let her rest two days later.

Edit: Just wanted to respond to their reply. The doctor never said anything about neoplasia nor did she explain that to me. She said she didn’t know what the sore on her tongue could be but theorized it could be kidney disease which she said would be unlikely since she was just tested for everything before her dental procedure, so you guys ran another blood work and deduced that it wasn’t kidney disease and gave me a recommendation to the dental specialist. She had cancer in her tongue that was metastasizing for weeks, likely months BEFORE I brought her in the first time, when I thought it was just a rotten tooth. It was already to the point that she was making a huge mess of her food and was turning her head side to side trying to pass the food around her mouth without the use of her tongue, and I showed videos of this before the dental cleaning and extraction appointment, at the FIRST dental consultation. This is to say that her tongue had already been adhering itself to the bottom of her mouth for weeks before her first appointment here, as evidenced by the videos I recorded for them. The second time I came back I showed a new video of my cat trying to enjoy one of those lickable treats but struggling, only then did it occur to anyone that the issue could be in her tongue.
The doctor they sent me to, Dr. Balke, could recognize right away from the videos of her eating, which were the same videos I showed the doctors here at her very first consult, that she had cancer. It just sucks to pay $900 to be told my cat is in great shape, just to be picking out her urn weeks later.
Our German Shepherd, Gigi, received compassionate and caring treatment at Phoenix Dog Cat Bird Hospital.
Thank you, Meghan, for recognizing our exceptional service with a five-star rating!

I brought my cat in for a dental cleaning and possible extractions. I was very clear that I did not want all her teeth removed. I was reassured that I was be contacted once she was sedated as to the extent of work needed. I was also supposed to be contacted when she was out of surgery and when she was ready to be picked up. None of this happened. I finally called in and was told my cat was ready for pickup.
After I pay the bill, I get to talk to the staff and find out that they have extracted all but four of her teeth and she needs to be on wet food for the rest of her life. I did not authorize this treatment. When I asked why I did not receive any calls during her procedure, I was told they called and left messages. I showed the assistant my phone confirmed my no calls or messages. I asked her to call me and the call did not go through to my phone. The assistant was totally not interested in the fact that that her calls didn’t go through. I asked her how I could get the proper care for me cat if the clinic couldn’t contact me. Once again, she seems indifferent to the situation.
My cat has been highly traumatized and has remained so for the last 48 hours. When I called the clinic yesterday to update them, I explained that my cat was still hiding and not eating. Therefore, I was unable to give her pain meds. Staff chastised me for not giving her meds even though it was impossible to do so.
No person or pet should have to go through what we went through. This clinic has no regard for a pet’s wellbeing or the pet owner’s specific instructions. Avoid Phoenix Dog Cat Bird Hospital and specifically Kaitlyn Schisler. They are a danger to your pet’s health.

Been a while since I've been in but staff is usually great. The new front desk staff however needs better training. I picked up remains and got nothing like I was being handed a purchase very gross attitude towards a patients death. Hopefully Stephanie doesn't retire anytime soon

My dog needed his teeth cleaned pretty badly and this team made me feel so supported and comforted throughout the process. From the front desk, the medical assistant, and the doctors. I needed help getting my dog inside with my two kids and they didn’t hesitate to help. Their compassion and support not just for the animals - but for the family is top notch.
I’m never disappointed in the care received. I’ve had to put 2 cats down here and we have a 7 year old dog that still goes for his checkups. Everyone who works there is always attentive and helpful.
Wonderful experience reasonably priced wonderful staff great attention to detail very caring absolutely wonderful!
Thank you, Antonio, for taking the time to share your five-star rating. Your feedback is truly appreciated and we are thrilled you had such a great experience.

Love this team. I adopted my dog from them 2 years ago due to the previous owner taking her in for Euthanasia. The vets refused and asked the owners to surrender her. She’s been with me for 2 years now, she is THE BEST Girl! Grateful for the vet team to use their care and support to do good. I only bring her here because I know that they actually care about the animals. <3
Love Dr Sosnow.  Bup does not like to go to the Vet.....but they make it as easy as possible.  Just wish everything was not so expensive....but it is everywhere now....certainly not just this Vet.

Everyone was incredibly kind and patient with both Navi and myself. What I thought was a small cut she was playing with ended up being cancer, and they were quick to diagnose it, schedule surgery and help with the recovery, which Navi fought every step of the way in true Bengal fashion. Thank you all for everything that you do, and for giving me more time with my sweet girl.

I took my 5 pound Yorkie (Sami) to Phoenix Dog Cat & Bird hospital.
The Vet Justine and her technician were wonderful with my little guy's allergies.
Not only was I happy with both their care & attention to Sami.
But, I was especially impressed that they worked with me and my strict budget.
Sami will be going
back for his next round of shots.
Thank you girls !
